translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: First, it's hot so I'll strip.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: With a bold rustle, Warg stripped completely naked.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「うおっ！？」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「……後は任せるわよ、ランス」

私は健太郎くんに手を伸ばして泣き叫んでいた。
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: I reached out to Kentaro-kun, crying and screaming.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: No matter how much I stretched my hand,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: the uncle holding me from behind kept me from reaching him.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: どうしてこんなことになってしまったんだろう……
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Why did it come to this...

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: I was supposed to be living as a normal girl,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: but this uncle said I would inherit the Demon King, and suddenly I was in another world.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: だから――
彼が助けに来てくれたとき、私とっても嬉しかったの。
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: When he came to save me, I was so happy.
